notes: Around 12 January 2018 (as reported), in Sayula de Aleman municipality, Veracruz, the heads of four dead men were found on the hood of a car, and their torsos inside the trunk of an abandoned car in San Isidro community. A narco message was left making reference to the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, and accusing the dead men of being oil thieves and killers. 4 fatalities.

On 10 February 2018, in Chimaltitan city, Jalisco, six members of a criminal gang, suspected New Generation Jalisco Cartel (CJNG), were killed in an ambush by another criminal gang, suspected Gulf Cartel members (Cartel del Golfo), and one was left wounded.
On 12 February 2018, in Barrio San Enrique, Ticul, Yucatan, an armed clash between Los Chulos and Los Pitos took place in the street. No injuries or fatalities reported.

On 17 February 2018, in Tzucacab, Yucatan, there was a clash between the Chulos and Pitos gangs. According to reports, the two bands were fighting in the street, and the Police arrived to disperse the gangsters. No fatalities or injuries reported. 3 men were arrested.

Around 11 March 2018 (as reported), in Villamar, Michoacan, the leader of the CJNG was killed by members of the Nueva Familia Michoacana. His body was found dismembered in Colonia La Enramada. The victim was a former member of the Nueva Familia Michoacana and later joined the CJNG Cartel. 1 fatality.

On 8 May 2018, in Reynosa, Tamaulipas, an armed clash between Los Metros and Los Escorpiones erupted during early morning hours close to El Campanario neighborhood. Reports informed of one man killed and one injured. Motives of the clash remain unclear.
On 9 May 2018, a raid on the Reynosa border of an armed convoy of the organised crime group Los Escorpiones triggered an armed clash with a cell of Los Metros Gang in Reynosa. 1 casualty reported.

On 28 May 2018, in Nuevo Progreso, Tamaulipas, close to the toll booth there was an armed clash between Los Escorpiones Gang and Los Metros Gang. Later in the afternoon, there was a convoy of at least 30 trucks and cars with the sign of the branch of Los Metros Gang known as M31 with unidentified objects burning. Neither fatalities nor injuries reported.

On 20 August 2018, in Los Guerra, Tamaulipas, an armed clash was reported between members of the North-East Cartel and members of the Los Metros Gang cartel who are part of the Gulf Cartel. The number of fatalities is unknown but reportedly, members of both gangs were killed in the clash. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 14 September 2018, in the Cuauhtemoc area of Ciudad de Mexico, Distrito Federal, three armed people dressed as Mariachi entered a building and opened fire against members of the Fuerza Anti Union. Three people died immediately and three died in the hospital. Other people resulted wounded as the perpetrators fled the scene. 6 fatalities.

Around 14 September 2018 (as reported), in Buenavista Tomatlan, Michoacan, several armed clashes took place between the CJNG and Los Viagras over the last two weeks, displacing 30 families from the municipalities seeking refuge in churches in Buenavista and Paracuaro. The arrest of 4 CJNG members were one of the reasons for armed clashes in the region.

On 17 September 2018, in Ciudad Miguel Aleman, Tamaulipas, there was an armed clash between Los Metros Gang who were protecting their territory against rivals from the CDN Cartel. No fatalities reported.

On 18 September 2018, in Reynosa, Tamaulipas, in the morning hours, there were armed clashes between Los Metros and their rivals, Los Escorpiones. There were burning cars and (narco) roadblocks on the roads leading out of the city. Shootings also took place in other Colonias of the city. 1 dead-body was found in Colonia Aztlan-Fuentes.
On the third week of Sept, members of Los Viagras and members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel engaged in an armed confrontation in Buenavista Tomatlan. No casualties were reported.

On 6 October 2018, in Reynosa, Tamaulipas, individuals belonging to the 'Panilo' cell of the Gulf Cartel and groups of 'Los Metros' held several armed clashes in various parts of the city and set a (narco) roadblock. Military and federal police, with the help of Civil Protection and Fire, intervened to remove the blockages. A suspected criminal was found dead inside a truck near the Libramiento R…

On 17 November 2018, in Nuevo Laredo, Tamaulipas, an alleged founder of the Zetas cartel was stabbed to death inside a jailed, controlled by the CDN Cartel. Later, the body of the victim was stolen from a funeral home, and parts of his body were found on 28 November along with other victims in Cadereyta Jimenez (coded separately) and in Monterrey. 1 fatality.

Around 28 November 2018 (as reported), in Cadereyta Jimenez, Nuevo Leon, an undetermined number of people were killed and their remains were found in front of a prison. The remains were inside an ice box along with a message signed by the Cartel del Noreste with threats to Los Zetas Vieja Escuela Gang. Some of the remains correspond to one of the founders of the Los Zetas Vieja Escuela Gang who w…

On 4 December 2018, in the municipality of Esperanza, Puebla, members of the CJNG and Los Zetas clashed on the road that connects Puebla to Orizaba. 7 members of Los Zetas died and their bodies were left on a road with a threatening message. 7 fatalities.

Around 9 December 2018 (as reported), in Salamanca, Guanajuato, two people were killed and their bodies were found dismembered with a narco-message signed by the Jalisco New Generation Cartel in the Ranch 'La Luz'. The victims are alleged members of the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel. 2 fatalities.
On 11 December 2018, in Colonia Revolucion, Venustiano Carranza, Ciudad de Mexico, members of the Tepito Union Cartel attacked a member of the Fuerza Anti-Union. The victim died in the attack.
On 13 December 2018, members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and Los Viagras clashed in Buenavista. No victims were reported.

On 16 December 2018, in Tlajomulco de Zuniga, Jalisco state, the leader of the Cartel Arellano Felix (CAF) in Tijuana was killed. According to the investigating authorities, the Cartel de Sinaloa (CDS) was behind the assassination.

On 19 January 2019 in Emiliano Zapata, Morelos, one woman was shot by several gunshots while having dinner in a restaurant. Hours later, four people were found dead in a car with their hands and feet tied. In colonia El Gante, the bodies of two men who were previously shot were found. According to authorities, this attack is a result of the fight between Los Rojos and Cartel de Jalisco Nueva Gene…

On 20 January 2019, in Emiliano Zapata, Morelos, a couple was shot several times by unknown attackers. According to authorities, this attack is a result of the fight between Los Rojos and Cartel de Jalisco Nueva Generacion. 2 fatalities.

On 20 January 2019, in Ciudad Ayala, Morelos, a man was found burnt. According to authorities, this attack is a result of the fight between Los Rojos and Cartel de Jalisco Nueva Generacion. 1 fatality.
On 22 January 2019, in Loreto, Zacatecas alleged members of the cartels Jalisco Nueva Generacion and Los Zetas-Talibanes clashed, and four alleged gang members died. 4 dead.

On 5 February 2019, alleged members of the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel attacked a vulcanizer in the 20 de Noviembre neighbourhood, Valle de Santiago town (Valle de Santiago, Guanajuato), shooting dead 5 people and severely injuring another person, all alleged CJNG members. The police forces believe the events are linked to feuds between gangs engaged in fuel theft.

On 5 February 2019, in Monterrey (Nuevo Leon), a dismembered head was found inside a black bag on the streets of Luis Mora and Miguel Nieto. Motive is linked to a dispute between the gangs of Cartel del Noroeste and Cartel del Golfo.

As reported on 28 February 2019, in Valle de Santiago (Guanajuato), members of the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel and suspected huachicoleros engaged in a shoot-out. According to reports, the armed clash was related to rivalries over hydrocarbon theft in the region. 5 suspects were killed, and no arrests were reported.

On 4 March 2019, in Apatzingan, an armed clash between two criminals groups took place, one called 'Los Viagras' and another from the CJNG: Jalisco New Generation Cartel. The clash affected 6 neighborhoods: El Duende, Lazaro Cardenas, Palmira, Las Palmas, Priest and Palo Alto. The shooting lasted around two hours, three policemen were injured.

On 9 March 2019, in Salamanca (Guanajuato), a group of 7 armed members of the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel started shooting indiscriminately against civilians at a club in the San Roque neighbourhood. The massacre took place in the context of on-going Police and Army operations to dismantle the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel, and it was reported that some of the victims belonged to the Jalisco New Genera…

Around 21 March 2019, in Guadalajara, Jalisco, a video of alleged members of CJNG-Cartel Jalisco New Generation surfaced on social media where alleged members kill an alleged member of Los Zetas in an unknown location. Precise date of killing is unclear.
Around 09 April 2019, an armed clash between members of the CJNG and Los Viagras was reported in the ranch San Jose de Chila, Apatzingan de la Constitucion. No fatalities or casualty reported.

On 18 April 2019, in Ticul, Yucatan, two rivalling criminal groups _os Chulos_and _os Pitos_clashed. Several persons were injured with bladed weapons. Even though security forces were alerted, no one was arrested.

notes: On 19 April 2019, in Minatitlan, Veracruz, members of Los Zetas Gang attacked the restaurant La Potra with the intent of killing its owner who was related to the CJNG: Jalisco New Generation Cartel. Preliminary investigations state that a private party held by the labour union of oil workers _eccion 10_was a collateral damage of the attack. 14 persons died, (6 women, 7 men, 1 baby), 5 more person…

On 13 May 2019, an armed clash between an armed group and the Tepito Union Cartel was registered in Tepito, Cuauhtemoc, Ciudad de Mexico. Three members of the Tepito Union Cartel died in the clash, and one was wounded, which indicates that the other group is most likely la Anti-Union. 3 fatalities, 1 casualty.

On 22 May 2019, an armed clash between members of the CJNG and Los Viagras Gang was registered in colonia Arroyo Colorado in Uruapan. 10 civilians died and 4-5 were wounded. 10 fatalities, 4 casualties.
On 30 May 2019, about 289 kilometers from Morelia, Michoacan, members of the CJNG and Los Viagras Gang clashed. Neither fatality nor injuries reported.
On 30 May 2019, in Pena Colorada, Aguililla, Michoacan, members of CJNG and Los Viagras Gang clashed. Neither fatality nor injuries reported.
On 30 May 2019, in Coalcoman, Michoacan, members of the CJNG and Los Viagras Gang clashed. Neither fatality nor injuries reported.

On 13 July 2019, in Tepito, Cuauhtemoc, Ciudad de Mexico, a member of a group known as 'Los Sinaloas' which is part of the Sinaloa Cartel, was attacked by members of the Tepito Union Cartel. The man died in the attack.

On 28 July 2019, in Cuauhtemoc, Ciudad de Mexico, DF, a shooting was registered in colonia Morelos, Tepito neighbourhood, resulting in the death of two persons and wounding of three persons. The exchange of fire is allegedly connected to rivalry between the Fuerza Anti Union and another criminal group. The victims allegedly were extortioners affiliated with the Union Tepito. 2 fatalities, 4 injur…

On 10 August 2019, in Madera, Chihuahua, an armed clash between members of the Gente Nueva Cartel and Sinaloa Cartel against Juarez and La Linea Gang was registered in Las Varas. The clash continued until 11 August and six people died. Six fatalities were split over two days.

On 11 August 2019, in Madera, Chihuahua, an armed clash between members of the Gente Nueva gang and Sinaloa Cartel against Juarez and La Linea Gang was registered in Las Varas. The clash started on 10 August and continued until 11 August. Six people died. Six fatalities were split over two days.

On 13 August 2019, possibly in Michoacan, a video showing how three alleged members of the CJNG are tortured by members of Los Viagra was released. It is not clear whether the three CJNG members are alive.

As reported on 4 September 2019, in a video published by the CJNG, members of this cartel killed a man who they mentioned belonged to the North-East Cartel. The video had a message to the police accusing them of defending the presence of this cartel in San Luis Potosi.
As reported on 12 September 2019, on a video recorded by members of the Familia Michoacana Cartel tortured a man of the CJNG. There is no information about the location of the event.

As reported on 7 October 2019, members of the North-East Cartel published a video showing the execution of three members of the CJNG and sending a threatening message to this Cartel who is sending men to Tamaulipas state.
On 21 October 2019, on the Tocumbo-Cotija highway, Michoacan, there was an armed clash between members of the CJNG and Los Viagras. 0 fatalities, 0 injuries
As reported on 28 October 2019, in Michoacan, members of La Familia Michoacana Cartel published a video in which they showed how they tortured and killed a member of the CJNG.

On 29 October 2019, in Xochitepec, Morelos, groups of prisoners clashed inside the Atlacholoaya prison. The clash was related to disputes for the control of the prison. One prisoner died and another one was injured.

On 30 October 2019, in Xochitepec, Morelos, prisoners members of the CJNG and Los Rojos clashed inside the Atlacholoaya prison. The clash was related to disputes for the control of the prison. According to reports, four prisoners died, among them a leader of the CJNG and a leader of Los Rojos, and 15 other were injured.

As reported on 15 December 2019, a video appeared on social networks showing an armed clash between members of the criminal group Los Metros and members of the North-East Cartel in the Municipality of Miguel Aleman, Taumalipas. It is not known when the confrontation took place or if there were any injuries or deaths.

As reported on 13 January 2020, in Churumuco de Morelos, Michoacan, there was an armed clash between members of CJNG and the Viagras cartel. The Municipal Police tried to intervene in the confrontation. Also, six vehicles were burned on the road to Zicuiran. 3 people died, 7 were injured and 4 police officers disappeared.
On 14 January 2020, in Zirandaro, Guerrero, members of the CJNG clashed with members of La Familia Michoacana Cartel. After the clash, police officers found one dead man.

On 04 February 2020, in Uruapan, Michoacan, after asking about two alleged members of the Viagras Cartel, four armed individuals shot at the people who were in a slot machine shop in Colonia La Magdalena. The shop was allegedly used as a drug outlet for the Viagra cartel. The perpetrators would be alleged members of a branch of the CJNG. Nine people died and two were injured.

On 5 February 2020, in Tangamandapio, Michoacan, armed groups clashed. Four men were found dead inside a car. Police officers found firearms inside the car and three of the victims were wearing military clothes. According to reports, the clash was between members of CJNG and Familia Michoacana Cartel.

On 8 February 2020, in Zirandaro, Guerrero, members of La Familia Michoana and CJNG clashed in EL Chivo village. According to reports, around 200 people displaced from El Chivo, La Calera and La Estancia communities fearing more clashes. Neither fatalities nor injuries reported.

As reported on 20 February 2020, members of the CJNG published a video in which they showed how they tortured and executed a member of Los Viagras. According to reports, these groups have increased their confrontation in Tamaulipas state.

As reported on 27 February 2020, members of the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel published a video in which the show how they torture and executed two members of the CNJG after they were kidnapped. The members of the CNJG were beheaded. According to reports, the conflict between both cartels is focused in Guanajuato state.

On 12 March 2020, near Doctor Coss, Nuevo Leon, an armed confrontation was reported between armed individuals in several vehicles on the road from Doctor Coss to the Pena Blanca-Santa Rosalia junction. After the confrontation, several burned-out vehicle were left behind and there are no reports of injuries. According to reports, the armed individuals were part of the Gulf Cartel and the North-Eas…
Around 18 March 2020 (as reported), in La Huacana municipality, Michoacan, members of CJNG clashed with the United Cartel. 18 fatalities split across 2 locations.
Around 18 March 2020 (as reported), in Aguililla municipality, Michoacan, members of CJNG clashed with the United Cartel. 18 fatalities split across 2 locations.

On 22 March 2020, in Tenango del Valle municipality, Mexico, a man, allegedly member of Los Viagras, was found dead at Santiaguito Coaxustenco bridge. The victim was beheaded and a threatening message against Los Viagras was left signed by CJNG. 1 fatality.

On 25 March 2020, in the Municipality of Aguililla, Michoacan, an armed clash between members of CJNG and the Viagra Gang was reported in the community of El Aguaje. According to reports in the confrontation at least 40 CJNG vans were involved. It is not known if there were any injuries or deaths

On 3 April 2020, in Madera, Chihuahua, the criminal group La Linea and the group Gente Nueva clashed. After the clash, police officers found 19 dead men, 1 injured, 18 firearms, two vehicles and two grenades in the place of the event. 19 fatalities and 1 injured.
On 14 April 2020, at the border between El Limoncito and El Aguaje in Aguililla municipality, Michoacan, members of the CJNG and Los Viagras clashed. Neither fatalities nor injuries reported.

As reported on 26 April 2020, in Aguililla municipality, Michoacan, an armed clash between members of CJNG and Los Viagras Gang was reported in the community of La Huerta. 12 men who were shot dead and 6 burned bodies were found. According to the report the inhabitants of the Huertas say they have found 3 extra dead bodies related to the event.

On 22 May 2020, in Puente Grande, Jalisco, prisoners who are members of CJNG and Sinaloa Carte clashed inside a prison. The prisoners used firearms. According to reports, the clash was related to disputes over the control of the prison. Eight men died and another eight were injured. 8 fatalities and 8 injured.

Around 23 May 2020 (as reported), in the Municipality of Huetamo, Michoacan, 12 alleged members of CJNG were killed and their bodies were found in a pickup truck near the border with the municipality of Altamirano, Guerrero along with a narco message signed by La Familia Michoacana who claimed responsibility for the attack with a video posted online. According to one report, the killings could ha…

Around 23 May 2020 (weekend of), near Doctor Coss, Nuevo Leon, several armed clashes between alleged members of The Gulf Cartel and the CDN were reported on the Pena Blanca-Comales road. The bodies of three people and two burned-out vans were found. According to the report there could have been up to 25 deaths but the bodies were not found.

On 25 May 2020, in the Municipality of Los Reyes (coded as Los Reyes de Salgado), Michoacan de Ocampo, suspected members of CJNG and CU (a partnership of several cartels, including CDG, Zetas, CDS) clashed on the Los Reyes-Tocumbo road. There were (narco) roadblocks as well, and at least two vehicles were burned. Casualties unknown.
On 27 May 2020, in Reynosa, Tamaulipas, members of the CDN, and the Gulf Cartel clashed. One man died. 1 fatality.

Around 1 June 2020 (as reported), in Cancun, Quintana Roo, a Venezuelan woman and alleged CDN member was killed and her body was found dismembered inside two bags. Next to the bags a threatening message was found addressed to several police commanders and signed by the CJNG. 1 fatality
On 8 June 2020, near Comales, Tamaulipas, members of CDN, and the Gulf Cartel clashed. Several trucks were set on fire in the place of the clash. Neither fatalities nor injuries reported.
On 14 June 2020, in Tepalcatepec municipality, Michoacan, members of CJNG and United Cartels clashed. Neither fatalities nor injuries reported.

Around 20 June 2020 (as reported), in Salamanca, Guanajuato, two men were killed and their dismembered bodies were found inside several bags in Colonia Constituyentes. The victims who were allegedly members of the CJNG were found along with a message and the alleged perpetrators were from the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel.

On 20 June 2020, in Culiacan Rosales, Sinaloa, an armed clash between Los Chapitos Gang and Los Mayito Gang was reported in Fraccionamiento Zona Dorada. It was a drive-by incident as the shots were fired from at least 4 vehicles. Some sources indicate that at least two people were injured.

On 24 June 2020, between La Mojonera and La Vainilla, Sinaloa, members of Los Chapitos clashed with members of Los Mayitos. These groups are identified as fractions of Sinaloa Cartel who separated after internal disputes. Allegedly ten men dressed with military equipment were found dead. Between 7 and 11 people died.

On 9 July 2020, in Bonifacio Moreno, Michoacan, armed clashes were reported between the CJNG and United Cartels (CU). Some reports say that the clash took place between members of the CJNG and Los Viagras Gang, members of the CU. Members of The Knights Templar Gang were seen travelling in armoured vans in the area. It is not known whether there were any injuries or deaths.

On 11 July 2020, in El Limoncito, Michoacan de Ocampo, members of CJNG and members of Los Viagras clashed. During the clash, (narco) roadblocks were set with vehicles set on fire. No casualties occurred.
On 12 July 2020, in Miguel Aleman municipality, Tamaulipas, members of the North-East cartel, and members of the Gulf Cartel clashed. Neither fatalities nor injured reported.
On 19 July 2020, in Miguel Aleman municipality, Tamaulipas, members of CDN and Gulf Cartel clashed. At least 4 men died. 4 fatalities.

Around 21 July 2020 (as reported), in El Aguaje, Michoacan, a video was published showing a clash allegedly between members of the CJNG and Los Viagras. Five men died and a threatening message left by the CJNG was found. 5 fatalities.

Around 25 July 2020 (as reported), in Ochoa, Tamaulipas, several videos were published on social networks showing a clash between members of the CDN and the Gulf Cartel. One of the videos shows the burned body of an alleged CDN member. It is not known if there were any more injuries or fatalities. 1 fatality.

On 25 July 2020, in La Estanzuela, Michoacan, a clash between members of the Grupo Elite and members of the United Cartels was reported on social networks. The authorities have not confirmed the clash and there are no reports of injuries.

Around 27 July 2020 (as reported), in Ochoa, Tamaulipas, members of the Gulf Cartel clashed with members of North-East Cartel. The Gulf Cartel published a video showing how they burned the bodies of members of CDN who died in the clash. Unknown fatalities coded as 3.

On 1 August 2020, between the municipalities of Bonifacio Moreno and Buenavista, Michoacan, the CJNG clashed with the CU on the Aptzingan-Aguililla road, between the communities of El Aguaje and El Tererrero. Roadblocks were also reported. 11 bodies were found.

On 9 September 2020, in Bonifacio Moreno, Michoacan, members of Los Viagras clashed with members of CJNG. A video was published by the United Cartel showing dead bodies of alleged members of the CJNG after the clash. One female leader of the CJNG was among the fatalities. At least 1 fatality.

On 15 September 2020, in Bonifacio Moreno, Michoacan, members of the CJNG clashed with members of the United Cartels. Before the clash, members of the CU had taken the village that was controlled by the CJNG who had to retreat following a security operation of the state forces. The CJNG came back to the community to retake control of it. Neither fatalities nor injuries reported.
On 15 September 2020, in Camargo, Tamaulipas, members of CJNG and the Gulf Cartel clashed. Three men died. 3 fatalities.

On 17 September 2020, in La Luz Texas, Guanajuato, members of CJNG clashed with members of Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel. One man died and another three were injured. The rest of the men escaped in several vehicles when National Guard officers arrived. 1 fatality.

Around 22 September 2020 (as reported), in Juan Aldama municipality, Zacatecas, a man was killed and his body was found along with a threatening message that accused him of collaborating with the extortions of the CJNG. The message was signed by the Sinaloa Cartel. 1 fatality.

Around 23 September 2020 (as reported), in Celaya, Guanajuato, a man who allegedly collaborated with Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel was killed and his dismembered body was found inside a box and some plastic bags in Colonia Tres Guerras. A threatening message signed by CJNG was left next to the victim. 1 fatality.
On 23 September 2020, in La Luz Texas, Guanajuato, members of the CJNG clashed with members of Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel. Two men died. 2 fatalities.

Around 23 September 2020 (as reported), in Altar, Sonora, members of the Caborca Cartel threw a grenade against a vehicle that was driven by members of Gente Nueva Gang. Neither fatalities nor injuries reported.

Around 6 October 2020 (as reported), in Yuriria municipality, Guanajuato, a video was published showing a clash between members of the CJNG and Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel. A civilian was injured by a stray bullet.
On 24 October 2020, in Villa Hermosa, Zacatecas, a clash between alleged members of the CJNG and the Sinaloa Cartel was reported in which three men died and three were injured.

On 10 November 2020, in the municipality of Camargo, Tamaulipas, members of the CDN and Los Metros gang, an armed wing of the Gulf Cartel, clashed in various points such as El Cadillo or Guardados. The clashes began after members of the Gulf Cartel (of which Los Metro gang is a part) stole the coffin of a CDN member. It is not known whether there were any injuries. [coded to Guardados de Abajo]

On 6 December 2020, in Tahuejo, Michoacan, an armed clash between the CJNG and Los Viagras Gang was reported. The clash was recorded and is circulating on social networks. Two women were killed and at least three were injured.

On 16 December 2020, in Fresnillo municipality, Zacatecas, there was an armed clash between members of the organized crime in San Isidro de Cabrales community. Five armed men died. According to the authorities, the event is allegedly linked to the fight between the Sinaloa Cartel (CDS) and the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG) that in three days led to 42 people killed. 5 fatalities.

Around 17 December 2020 (as reported), in Villa Hidalgo, Zacatecas, two people were killed. According to the authorities, the event is allegedly linked to the fight between the Sinaloa Cartel (CDS) and the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG) that in three days led to 42 people killed. 2 fatalities.

On 17 December 2020, in Jerez de Garcia Salinas municipality, Zacatecas, there was an armed clash between two groups of the organized crime in El Salitrillo community. Two armed men died. According to the authorities, the event is allegedly linked to the fight between the Sinaloa Cartel (CDS) and the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG) that in three days led to 42 people killed. 2 fatalities.

On 22 December 2020, in Jerez de Garcia Salinas, Zacatecas, there was an armed clash between alleged members of the CJNG and the Sinaloa Cartel. There were videos recorded showing people running away while there was a shooting in the background. The videos were shared on social media. Three people were injured.

On 24 December 2020, in Aguililla municipality, Michoacan, there was an armed clash between the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and Los Viagras in El Aguaje community. The event was recorded on video and shared on social media.

On 30 December 2020, in Tangancicuaro municipality, Michoacan (coded to Tangancicuaro de Arista), there was an armed clash between armed men on the road that connects the town of Gomez Faroas to San Antonio Ocampo. When the police arrived to the area, they found a man killed with his hands and feet tied and gunshot wounds. It is presumed that the clash was between members of CJNG and CU. 1 fatali…

On 4 January 2021, in Leon de los Aldama, Guanajuato, five people were shot and killed by armed men inside an apartment in Colonia Villa Insurgentes. According to the authorities, this event could be related to the dispute between different organized crime groups, mainly the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel. 5 fatalities.

Around 6 January 2021 (as reported), in Celaya, Guanajuato, members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel torture a woman who was an alleged member of the Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel. The event was recorded on video and share on social media. Her body was later found on December 6, dismembered inside a suitcase and two plastic bags in Colonia Ejidal and in Colonia Paseo de San Nicolas de Parra with…

On 7 January 2021, in Celaya, Guanajuato, nine men were shot and killed by armed men who interrupted a funeral and shot at them in barrio de Arboledas de San Rafael. The perpetrators arrived in two cars. One man was shot and injured too. According to the authorities, this event could be related to the dispute between different organized crime groups, mainly the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and t…

Around 15 January 2021 (as reported), around Santa Maria Miramar, Michoacan, there was an armed clash between the United Cartels and the Jalisco New Generation Cartel between Santa Maria Miramar and Zapotan. Allegedly 7 members of the United cartels died. 7 fatalities.

Around 17 January 2021 (between 17 - 18 January), around Donaciano Ojeda, Michoacan, there was an armed clash between members of the CJNG and the United Cartel (CU). Between thirteen to fifteen people were killed and their bodies were found with gunshot wounds along the roads in Valle verde and Donaciano Ojeda. At least 13 fatalities.

Around 26 January 2021 (as reported), in Ciudad Miguel Aleman, Tamaulipas, there was an alleged clash between the Gulf Cartel and the Cartel del Noreste. The shooting was recorded on video and shared on social media. No fatalities reported.

Around 29 January 2021 (as reported), in the municipality of Chinicuila, Michoacan (coded to Villa Victoria), an armed clash between the CJNG and United Cartels was reported on the Apatzingan-Cuatro Caminos road. A CU member, formally member of The Knights Templar gang was killed. 1 fatality.

On 6 February 2021, in Aguililla municipality, Michoacan, there was an armed clash among members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG) and members of the United Cartels (CU) in Palo Dulce and El Aguaje communities. The clash started after members of the CJNG arrived in the municipality. The Aguililla militia and Los Viagras gang joined the CU to fight against the CJNG. Allegedly eight peopl…

On 10 February 2021, in the municipality of Jerez, Zacatecas (coded to Jerez de Garcia Salinas), an armed clash between the Sinaloa Cartel and the CJNG was reported between Barrio San Isidro and the rural community of Los Cardos. During the clash, two vehicles were burned and two houses were shot at. Two people died. 2 fatalities.
